sentences.l2: 周末整理房间时，我决定在闲鱼上淘几件二手家具。
sentences.l1: While tidying my room at the weekend, I decided to hunt for a few pieces of second-hand furniture on Xianyu.

sentences.l2: 刷了半小时，我看中一张实木餐桌，卖家描述说九成新，成色几乎与新品无异，标价却只有原价的三分之一。
sentences.l1: After browsing for half an hour, I took a liking to a solid-wood dining table; the seller's description said it was 90 percent new, its condition almost no different from a new one, yet the asking price was only one third of the original.

sentences.l2: 我随即发消息询问，得知桌子是搬家前购置的，仅用过一年，桌角有一道浅浅的划痕。
sentences.l1: I immediately sent a message to ask, and learned that the table had been bought before a house move, had been used for only one year, and had a shallow scratch on a corner.

sentences.l2: 于是我以此为切入点开始砍价，语气客气但态度明确：我可以当天上门自提，省下物流费和包装成本，希望对方让出两百元。
sentences.l1: So I used this as an entry point to start bargaining, with a polite tone but a clear stance: I could come in person to pick it up that same day, saving the logistics fee and packaging costs, and I hoped the other party would take off 200 yuan.

sentences.l2: 卖家犹豫片刻，最终同意降价一百五，并约定次日下午在小区门口交接。
sentences.l1: The seller hesitated for a moment, and in the end agreed to lower the price by 150 yuan, and they arranged to hand it over at the entrance of the residential compound the next afternoon.

sentences.l2: 见面时我仔细检查了桌面的成色与结构，确认没有开裂或虫蛀，便当场转账，又叫了辆小货车把桌子运回家。
sentences.l1: When we met, I carefully checked the condition and structure of the tabletop, and after confirming there were no cracks or woodworm, I transferred the money on the spot, then called a small van to carry the table home.

sentences.l2: 整个过程不到十分钟，我既省下了钱，也避免了网购家具难以预料的尺寸与色差问题。
sentences.l1: The whole process took less than ten minutes, and I both saved money and avoided the unpredictable problems of size and color difference that come with buying furniture online.
